items.title: Return signed lease and proof of deposit transfer
items.quote:
To complete the booking, please return the signed lease together with proof that you have
transferred the deposit by 08/09/2027.
items.computation: The letter prints the deadline only as the numeric date '08/09/2027', with no day name or other date on the letter to disambiguate the format. German convention (and the company's German-language letterhead/address in Hamburg) would read this as DD/MM/YYYY = 8 September 2027. However, the letter is addressed to an international resident and written entirely in English, which commonly uses MM/DD/YYYY = 9 August 2027. Both readings are internally consistent with the document date of 07/07/2027 (7 July 2027), so nothing in the letter settles which format was intended. Following the rule to take the earliest plausible reading when a date can be read two ways, the earlier of the two (9 August 2027, MM/DD/YYYY) is used as due_date, but the true deadline may in fact be 8 September 2027 if the sender used DD/MM/YYYY.

warnings: The deadline is printed only as the numeric date '08/09/2027', which can be read as 9 August 2027 (MM/DD/YYYY, English format) or 8 September 2027 (DD/MM/YYYY, German format); the letter gives no other clue to resolve this, so the earlier reading (9 August 2027) was used but the real deadline could be a month later — confirm the intended date with the Lettings Team before relying on it.

No deposit amount, lease document, or payment account details beyond the sender's own IBAN are specified in this letter; verify the deposit sum and any payment instructions directly with the lessor through a channel you already trust before transferring money.
